subject: Language
title: Alphabet & First Phonics
subtitle: Phonics, Vowels & Letters A to Z
author: Distinguished Curators & Academic Press

pages.title: Letter A: The Great Explorer
bulletPoints: Capital A stands tall with two walking legs and a belt across: A.
Phonics sound: /æ/ like in Apple, Astronaut, and Alligator.
Action words: Act, Add, Ask, and Aim high into the blue sky.
Rhyme: An Apple A day keeps the doctor Away!

pages.title: Letter B: The Bouncing Bear
bulletPoints: Capital B has a tall straight spine and two round bellies: B.
Phonics sound: /b/ like in Butterfly, Banana, Ball, and Boat.
Action words: Bounce, Build, Breathe, and Bake delicious bread.
Rhyme: Busy Brown Bears picking Blue Berries in the forest.

pages.title: Letter C: The Curved Cat
bulletPoints: Capital C is a wide, welcoming open curve: C.
Hard /k/ sound: Cat, Castle, Carrot, Cup, and Candle.
Soft /s/ sound: City, Circle, and Ceiling when followed by E or I.
Rhyme: Clever Cats Climb Curious Castle walls calmly.

pages.title: Letter D: The Dancing Dolphin
bulletPoints: Capital D has one straight back and one giant round stomach: D.
Phonics sound: /d/ like in Dolphin, Drum, Duck, and Diamond.
Action words: Dance, Dive, Discover, and Dream colorful dreams.
Rhyme: Delightful Ducks Dabble Down Deep in the pond.

pages.title: Letter E: The Energetic Elephant
bulletPoints: Capital E has one tall backbone and three reach-out arms: E.
Short /e/ sound: Elephant, Egg, Engine, and Echo.
Long /iː/ sound: Eagle, Eat, and Easy reading.
Rhyme: Eager Elephants Exercise Every single Evening.

pages.title: Letter F: The Flying Fox
bulletPoints: Capital F has one tall line and two floating shelves: F.
Phonics sound: /f/ like in Fox, Flower, Feather, and Firefly.
Action words: Fly, Float, Find, and Foster loving friendships.
Rhyme: Four Fast Frogs Frolic in Fresh Forest Ferns.

pages.title: Letter G: The Gentle Giraffe
bulletPoints: Capital G curves like a C with a friendly inward bench: G.
Hard /g/ sound: Garden, Guitar, Goose, and Golden sunshine.
Soft /dʒ/ sound: Giant, Gem, and Giraffe reaching high treetops.
Rhyme: Green Grass Grows Gently in Grandma’s Garden.

pages.title: Letter H: The Happy Horse
bulletPoints: Capital H has two tall pillars holding hands with a bridge: H.
Phonics sound: /h/ like in Horse, House, Heart, and Honey.
Action words: Hop, Hug, Help, and Hear the morning birds.
Rhyme: Happy Horses Hop High over Helpful wooden Hurdles.

pages.title: Letters I & J: Iguana & Jellyfish
bulletPoints: Letter I: Ice cream, Island, Iguana, and Ink bottle.
Letter J: Jumping Jellyfish, Joyful Juggler, and Juicy Jam.
Action words: Imagine, Illustrate, Jump, and Join hands.
Phonics fun: /ɪ/ in Igloo and /dʒ/ in Jungle safari.

pages.title: Letters K & L: Kangaroo & Lion
bulletPoints: Letter K: Kangaroo, Kite, King, and Koala in eucalyptus trees.
Letter L: Lion, Lemon, Lantern, and Lovely Lily flower.
Phonics contrast: Crisp /k/ in Kitten and flowing /l/ in Lotus.
Rhyme: Little Kangaroos Kick and Lovely Lions Laugh softly.

pages.title: Letters M & N: Monkey & Nest
bulletPoints: Letter M: Mountain peaks, Monkey, Moon, and Mother’s love.
Letter N: Nature, Nest, Needle, and Nighttime stars.
Nasal sounds: Gentle humming /m/ and ringing /n/.
Rhyme: Many Monkeys Marvel at Nine New bird Nests.

pages.title: Letters O & P: Owl & Penguin
bulletPoints: Letter O: Ocean, Octopus, Orange, and Wise Old Owl.
Letter P: Penguin, Peacock, Peach, and Purple Paint.
Round vowel /ɒ/ and popping consonant /p/.
Rhyme: Polite Penguins Paint Pretty Purple Pictures patiently.

pages.title: Letters Q & R: Queen & Rainbow
bulletPoints: Letter Q: Always travels with best friend U! Queen, Quilt, and Quick.
Letter R: Radiant Rainbow, Rabbit, River, and Rose.
Sounds: /kw/ in Quiet and rolling /r/ in River running.
Rhyme: Quiet Queens Read Rhymes under Radiant Rainbows.

pages.title: Letters S & T: Sun & Tiger
bulletPoints: Letter S: Sinuous Snake, Smiling Sun, and Sparkling Star.
Letter T: Tall Tree, Tiger, Teapot, and Train tracks.
Sounds: Hissing /s/ and tapping dental /t/.
Rhyme: Seven Shining Stars Smile down on Tiny Tigers.

pages.title: Letters U & V: Umbrella & Violin
bulletPoints: Letter U: Umbrella, Unicorn, Uniform, and Upward swing.
Letter V: Violin, Velvet, Volcano, and Vegetable garden.
Sounds: Upbeat short /ʌ/ and buzzing vibrant /v/.
Rhyme: Violet Violins Vibrate Under Velvet Umbrellas.

pages.title: Letters W & X: Whale & Xylophone
bulletPoints: Letter W: Blue Whale, Windmill, Watermelon, and Winter breeze.
Letter X: Xylophone music, X-ray fish, and Box / Fox endings.
Sounds: Rounded /w/ and crisp ending /ks/.
Rhyme: Wonderful Whales Wave through Water without worry.

pages.title: Letters Y & Z: Yak & Zebra
bulletPoints: Letter Y: Yellow Yacht, Yak in mountains, and sweet Yummy Yogurt.
Letter Z: Zigzag Zebra, Zipper, and buzzing Honeybee Zone.
Final letters: Completing the 26 magical keys of English reading!
Rhyme: Zebras Zigzag through Yellow Yards with Zest!

pages.title: The Vowel Family: A, E, I, O, U
bulletPoints: Every English word must have at least one vowel to make a sound.
Short sounds: Cat /æ/, Bed /e/, Sit /ɪ/, Hot /ɒ/, Sun /ʌ/.
Long sounds: Say their own letter names: Bake, Pete, Pine, Rose, Cube.
The singing vowels give warmth and voice to all the consonants!

pages.title: Word Families: Rhyme and Read
bulletPoints: -AT family: Cat, Hat, Bat, Mat, Rat, Sat on the mat.
-OG family: Dog, Fog, Log, Frog jumping off the log.
-IN family: Pin, Tin, Win, Spin the top to win.
-UN family: Sun, Fun, Run, Bun fresh out of the oven!

pages.title: The Alphabet Champion: A to Z Master
bulletPoints: 26 Letters mastered: From A for Apple all the way to Z for Zebra.
You now hold the keys to read thousands of storybooks and poems.
Keep practicing reading signs, labels, and favorite picture tales.
Celebrate: Sing the Alphabet Song with joy and pride!
